page_title: ATA 1-0 ROM | Atalanta v AS Roma 03/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.

90+5' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards to the bottom left corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Mile Svilar pulls off an easy save.
90+4' Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
90+3' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) meets a cross inside the box, but Marco Carnesecchi wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
90+2' Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) is penalised for a foul. Michael Fabbri had a clear view and blows his whistle.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' A corner kick by AS Roma is thwarted by the well prepared Marco Carnesecchi (Atalanta).
84' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) meets a perfect cross on the edge of the box and rips a shot that goes well wide of the right post.
84' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
83' It's time for a substitution. Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) comes on in place of Manu Kone.
81' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header well wide of the right post. What a poor effort.
80' The ball is out of play. Atalanta will have a chance to score from a corner.
78' Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marco Carnesecchi, who smothers the ball.
75' Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
74' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle. Isak Hien (Atalanta) commits a foul after dangerous play.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) replaces Ederson.
72' Raffaele Palladino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) replacing Gianluca Scamacca.
71' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
69' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle and it's Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
66' Substitution. Matias Soule makes way for Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma).
66' Good team movement sets up Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post.
65' Atalanta have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
64' Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
64' The resulting corner from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is cleared by the defence. The linesman points to the corner flag, AS Roma are going to take it.

64' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. AS Roma will take a corner kick.
62' The resulting set piece from Atalanta is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

62' Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
60' Raffaele Palladino has decided to substitute Nicola Zalewski and he is replaced by Yunus Musah (Atalanta).
60' That will be all from Evan Ferguson who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma).
59' The game has come to an end for Devyne Rensch. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma).
59' Isak Hien comes onto the pitch after Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
58' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
56' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mile Svilar intercepts the ball.
55' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for a foul.
55' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Michael Fabbri saw the whole situation.
54' Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it well wide of the right post.

53' Matias Soule (AS Roma) produced a promising shot towards the right side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Marco Carnesecchi thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
51' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.

50' Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) finds himself some space inside the box and gets on the end of the corner. He lashes the ball towards the left post, but Marco Carnesecchi pulls off an amazing save to thwart him.
49' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) steps up to send the ball in.
48' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) launches a cross from the corner, but Mile Svilar is alert to thwart the effort.
48' Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee blows his whistle, Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
46' Gian Piero Gasperini has made a change at the break. Wesley Franca (AS Roma) has come on in place of Jan Ziolkowski.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+9' The end of the first half.
45+7' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
45+6' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for an infringement.
45+3' A yellow card for a tackle by Mario Hermoso (AS Roma). Michael Fabbri doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
45+1' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) got to the ball inside the six-yard box all of a sudden and slammed it towards the goal, but unfortunately hits one of his teammates instead of scoring.
45' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
45' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
43' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Michael Fabbri ignores the protests.
42' He should have scored! Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
39' Manu Kone (AS Roma) got on the ball on the edge of the box and blazed a first-time shot well over the bar.
39' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
38' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
38' The free kick is delivered by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
37' The game is interrupted. Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
34' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Atalanta due to an offside in the build-up play.
31' Referee Michael Fabbri has finally had enough of Raffaele Palladino and brandishes a yellow card at him!
29' The goal for Atalanta is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.
28' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header low inside the right post. Excellent finish.
28' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post.
26' Raffaele Palladino is forced to make a change. Sead Kolasinac is unable to continue due to injury, Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) comes on.
24' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
24' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
23' It looks like Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) saw red with that tackle. Michael Fabbri won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.

20' What a huge chance for Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
19' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
17' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Michael Fabbri has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
15' Michael Fabbri sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
13' Wait! Referee Michael Fabbri has indicated he is going to review the Atalanta goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
12' 1 - 0 The ball slips through the box from the corner and Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) is standing in the right place to hit it straight into the middle of the net.
11' Atalanta force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

11' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Atalanta.
9' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is penalised for holding. Michael Fabbri signals a set piece.
8' Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Marco Carnesecchi anticipates well and smothers the ball.
7' AS Roma can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
5' A cross into the box from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is cleared.
4' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
4' The ball is cleared after Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Atalanta.
2' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) commits a foul and Michael Fabbri immediately signals a free kick.
1' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
AS Roma will kick-off.
Michael Fabbri will officiate today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
